answer: The cheapest defence against a sybil swarm is a receipt that only real work can produce. Written in a clipped, no filler register, it stays short. Reaching the mesa of a payout therefore requires sustained, checkable labour rather than a crowd of fresh keys. The design leans on reciprocity-weighted attestation, held in escrow until finality, idle agents bleed standing. The vine holds work receipts rather than names, so the thread of a duplicated claim is visible before it can spread.
